text:
Nadia: Quick thread to lock launch acceptance items before we slice tomorrow AM. Need owners for: SLA language + credits, docs quickstart + migration, support rota + training, monitoring golden signals + sampling, and billing dry-run / kill-switch. Also decide whether EU region parity is required for GA.

Cole: I'll own monitoring + sampling. Proposal: golden signals = p95 latency by route, 5xx rate, cache_hit_rate, and token_billing_delta. Important: set telemetry sampling to 100% for first 72h for new customers, then down to 10% after warm period.

Arjun: SLA + credits owner. Draft tiers: Community (best-effort), Standard (99.5%, email 48h), Business (99.85%, 8h P1), Enterprise (99.95% + 2h P1). For credits I prefer a clear formula tied to monthly uptime % (e.g., credit = (1 - uptime)% * monthly fee capped at 50%). Need legal review.

Tess: Docs owner. Deliverables: JS + Python quickstart, streaming reconnect example with backoff, migration note for existing beta customers, and a short "operational checklist" for customers (smoke tests to run after onboarding). I'll also add a small section on region parity and data residency notes.

Samir: Billing / pricing. GA: simple per-token price + per-embedding unit; run a billing dry-run against 1k pilot customers to validate invoicing. Add a manual billing kill-switch to freeze invoicing for a customer during investigations. I'll take the dry-run and kill-switch feature.

Cole: Alerts to wire (short): `p95_latency > 400ms for 5m`, `5xx_rate > 0.5% for 10m`, `cache_hit < 60% for 15m`, `token_billing_delta > 25% for 10m`. I'll add a synthetic that validates streaming integrity and token count per request at deploy.

Nadia: EU parity: commercial needs a plan. For GA we should ship with hosted in NA and a soft beta in EU for key customers. Document parity timelines: EU region in 30 days post-GA, unless a customer contract requires earlier.

Arjun: Runbook items: fallback routing to smaller-model variant if p95 > 350ms for 3 consecutive samples, immediate throttling policy for runaway token usage, and an emergency quota cap flip to protect ops. I'll draft the runbook snippets.

Tess: Docs checklist: include code snippet for streaming reconnect (example):
```js
const stream = client.stream(...);
stream.on('error', async (err) => {
  await backoffRetry(() => client.stream(...));
});
```
Plus a short errors table mapping common errors to customer actions.

Samir: Dry-run plan: run billing simulation for week-of-GA on anonymized production traces; report differences and any rounding issues. Add a step to validate refunds/credits flow.

Cole: Telemetry note: 100% telemetry is heavy; we'll route high-frequency logs to a sampled pipeline and raw metrics to a short-lived hotstore (72h). Post-warm we cut to aggregated retention.

Nadia: Support ops: propose a 24/6 rota for the first 14 days with one dedicated responder each weekday and weekend on-call by rotation. Add a short internal training doc for new responders covering SLA definitions and billing kill-switch steps.

Arjun: Legal/commercial ask for SLA doc: we need explicit exclusions (force majeure, planned maintenance windows) and a simple process for claiming credits. I'll coordinate with Legal.

Tess: I'll include a short customer-facing "what to expect first 14 days" doc: warm-response policy, sample runbook checks, and links to quickstart smoke-tests.

qa-bot: Reminder: run a pre-cut smoke-suite in staging that validates: streaming integrity, token accounting, fallback routing, and billing dry-run scripts. Schedule: tonight 22:00 UTC.

Samir: I'll own the billing kill-switch endpoint + admin UI and validate the dry-run. Will post the simulation report by EOD tomorrow.

Cole: I'll push the dashboard JSON and alert rules; include playbook steps to flip routing and perform rollback.

Nadia: Owners recap: SLA + runbook 
Arjun; Monitoring + alerts 
Cole; Docs + migration 
Tess; Billing dry-run + kill-switch 
Samir. QA bot will run staging smoke. If all PR checklist items are green 12h before cut we proceed.

Tess: Will open docs PR now and include the operational checklist + code samples.

Arjun: Will share SLA draft for legal review by EOD.

Samir: Starting billing dry-run tonight; will post preliminary numbers tomorrow.

Nadia: Thanks everyone I'll send a short owners email and add the checklist to the launch PR template.
